t: Introduction and overview — Essex-class Aircraft Carrier
name: Introduction and overview — Essex-class Aircraft Carrier — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Essex-class Aircraft Carrier
description: Introduction and overview of the Essex-class Aircraft Carrier: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Essex class — 24 built — was the U.S. Navy's World War II carrier fleet: 27,100 tons carrying 90-100 aircraft. Essex carriers won the Pacific war, then served through Korea and Vietnam with angled-deck modernizations. Four became museum ships, including Yorktown, Intrepid, Hornet, and Lexington. Baseline facts: U.S. WWII aircraft carrier; 24 built; 90-100 aircraft; won the Pacific war..
